jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or per mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Your role at CGM: As a leading company in software solutions for the healthcare sector, we operate in 19 countries and employ almost 9,000 dedicated people. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment that is full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a lasting difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We are looking for people who feel the power of AI in the eHealth environment, want to help shape change, and recognize with curious passion how technology - from modern frontends and cloud platforms to AI-based solutions - can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world in which knowledge saves lives!

You lead an international team of frontend and backend developers, quality assurance, DevOps engineers, and Scrum Masters through the agile development process and ensure the use of modern cloud and AI technologies.
You take care of onboarding, training, and developing employees, define recruiting standards and processes, and actively foster skills in frontend, DevOps, cloud, and AI.
You scale the agile processes within the department, divide the team into three independent Scrum teams, and integrate international colleagues into a unified cloud- and DevOps-oriented delivery structure.
You coordinate and implement the technical requirements in a modern cloud environment (incl. CI/CD, monitoring, security) and work closely with other departments to ensure smooth integration into the existing system landscape.
In addition, you design and prepare the Executive Board resolution on partial decryption and take on the technical implementation and verification using secure cloud services and, where appropriate, AI-supported methods.

Completed vocational training, e.g. as an IT specialist (m/f/d), or a degree in IT, e.g. Informatics, Computer Science, or Software Engineering.
Proven experience in leading Scrum development teams and applying Scrum methods, as well as the ability to motivate and lead an international team in a DevOps and cloud environment.
Proven experience in desktop and web development in frontend, backend, or full stack - ideally with responsive UI, modern frameworks, and integration into cloud services.
In-depth knowledge of relevant programming languages and technologies (e.g. HTML5, CSS / SASS and JavaScript or TypeScript, Java, Go), hands-on experience in DevOps (e.g. CI/CD, containers, Infrastructure as Code) and cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), as well as an interest in AI/ML technologies and strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills round off your profile.
Strong communication skills, a team-oriented mindset, and very good German and English skills.

Feel Good Management: We offer you fresh food every day with a varied selection of dishes.
Health: Use the gym and attend our free sports classes.
Childcare: Our on-site kindergarten enables you to work more flexibly.
Events: Take part in internal events and activities, which take place regularly on site as well as remotely.
Ergonomics: Set up your workplace so that it meets your ergonomic needs and you can work comfortably and healthily on site.
Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardless of disability, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, age, or personal orientation and identity.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about bringing innovation to our equine customers to improve the lives of horses and the people who love them? We're seeking for a customer focused, results driven business leader to join our global equine business to continue building and leading a customer centric innovation roadmap in line with the business segment strategy.
This is an important leadership position within the global equine team. You will foster cross-functional collaboration together with R&D, Supply, Regions and Countries and move Innovation/Business Development projects forward. You will lead the commercial perspective of projects, support long-term pipeline forecasting, and manage strategic business model innovation initiatives.
If you believe that this is the next career move for you, we look forward to receiving your dedicated application and getting to know you further!
This position has a hybrid setup with at least three days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will work closely with Global Head Equine GSM, Equine Franchise Managers and Technical Service Managers to ensure that a consistent overall innovation roadmap is put together and implemented in line with Business Segment strategy.
- As part of this you will be responsible for driving the GSM input on BD&L and R&D potential pipeline opportunities in alignment with the Business Segment Strategy.
- Your lateral leadership skills will help you to foster cross-functional collaboration together with R&D, Supply, Regions and Countries teams for internal innovation and BD&L projects.
- You will champion the Global Strategic Marketing (GSM) needs during project development management within project teams, leading commercial perspective in projects and drive the GSM input into appropriate prioritization for research projects within sub-franchise portfolio including project status tracking and stakeholder communications.
- You will lead commercial input into product profiles from strategic and business perspectives.
- Finally, in close collaboration with Global Head Equine GSM and franchise managers, you will derive global forecasting assumptions and review / align them with key countries as needed.

Requirements

- Master degree in the field of Veterinary science or similar required.
- Highly specialized knowledge and experience in the field of equine health with a deep understanding of the therapeutic and veterinary science areas and customer needs in this field
- Strong lateral leadership skills to foster cross-functional work
- Ability to communicate decisions to senior stakeholders in an international/cross-cultural matrix environment
- Strong financial and business acumen
- Strong strategic and analytical capabilities
- Excellent knowledge of English, further languages of advantage

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: AMHS Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) Become the heart of our fab
automation. The Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) will be the
nervous system of our fab. As an AMHS Hardware Engineer, you’ll be a
technical expert, designer, problem-solver, and team leader. You’ll
ensure that our wafer transport systems (transfer tools, sorters, N2
systems) operate at maximum efficiency. Tasks Your Mission: Take the
lead on hardware performance and drive technological development:
System Optimization & Setup: You will be responsible for the
installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of our AMHS
hardware. In-Depth Troubleshooting: For complex issues, you will
conduct root cause analyses (8D, FMEA, SPC) and implement sustainable
solutions. Project Management: You will lead cross-functional projects
aimed at improving productivity, quality, and cost efficiency—from
planning through to performance review. Technology Scouting: You will
evaluate new equipment and materials, work closely with suppliers, and
develop in-house hardware solutions to meet operational needs.
Leadership & Mentoring: You will lead and mentor a team of technicians
and junior engineers, share your knowledge, and foster team spirit
through clear communication. Fab Setup: You will actively assist with
installation and coordinate upgrades in close collaboration with other
departments. Profile You are a proactive team player who thrives in a
dynamic, fast-paced environment and is willing to take on
responsibility. Qualifications: A Master’s degree in Engineering,
such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Automation, or a related
field. Experience: Professional experience in the semiconductor
industry is required. Technical expertise: In-depth knowledge of
optimization algorithms, control systems, and mechanical automation.
Methodological skills: Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA,
and 8D problem-solving. Personality: Hands-on mentality, resilience,
and the ability to motivate and lead teams professionally. Language:
Fluent in English (company language). Basic communication skills in
Mandarin or German is a plus. Training: Available for on-the-job
training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months. Location: Dresden, Germany We
offer Each journey starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this
early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively
shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your
true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced,
international startup environment whilst at the same time having
access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and
most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have
ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital
Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both
in Taiwan and other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most
advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is
fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and
Customer Trust (ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive
leadership and passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our
people vision: create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and
enable the best in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal
employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color,
ethnic and national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental
disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation,
gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital
status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or
any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
Additional contact details Please apply with your English resume. The
ESMC recruiting team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits
the hiring criteria.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d) (Ausbildungsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About us The European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
is a joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP. For the
first time, TSMC, the global technology leader, is establishing a
semiconductor fabrication plant in the heart of Europe, offering
leading-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation
semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For our future fab
in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated:
Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d)
Are you ready to strategically and pedagogically lead the end-to-end
apprentice journey for Europe's newest, most advanced semiconductor
facility? As a Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational
Training (m/f/d) at ESMC in Dresden, you will move beyond standard
administration to drive collaborative success across all core phases
of our technical vocational education. You will be the architect of
our future talent pipeline— managing employer branding at schools,
coordinating dual-training plans, mentoring Gen-Z apprentices, and
ensuring legal compliance. Fitting into our fast-paced greenfield
environment, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the next
generation of microtechnology and industrial specialists from the
ground up! Tasks Talent Attraction & Recruitment: Design and execute
targeted school marketing strategies, represent ESMC at career fairs,
manage the applicant pipeline, conduct interviews, and issue
apprenticeship contracts. Onboarding & Pastoral Care: Serve as the
primary point of contact and dedicated mentor for future apprentices,
coordinating orientation phases and providing continuous coaching.
Training Curriculum Coordination: Design dual-training plans, manage
internal rotations across manufacturing departments, and coordinate
closely with local vocational schools (Berufsschulen).
Train-the-Trainer Support: Provide ongoing pedagogical and structured
guidance to our operational Fab trainers on the manufacturing floor.
Legal Compliance: Ensure full operational compliance with the German
Vocational Training Act (BBiG), the Youth Employment Protection Act
(JArbSchG), and other relevant educational laws. Key Stakeholder
Management: Build and maintain excellent collaborative relationships
with the local Works Council (Betriebsrat/JAV), vocational schools,
and local chambers (IHK). Graduation & Placement: Coordinate final
exam preparations, align with department managers to map out
post-graduation career pathways, and handle transition contract
processes. Profile Must-Have: Certifications: Holder of the AdA-Schein
(AEVO / Ausbildereignungsprüfung)—the mandatory qualification to
train apprentices in Germany. Education: Academic degree (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
or certified technical expert background (Staatlich geprüfter
Techniker) with a verified trainer/tester license. Experience: 5+
years of professional experience managing vocational training programs
within a technical, manufacturing, or industrial environment (e.g.,
semiconductor, automotive, automation, or chemical industries).
Regulatory & Institutional Knowledge: Strong, practical experience
working successfully with the IHK and a deep understanding of German
legal frameworks (BBiG, JArbSchG, and BetrVG). Languages: Fluent
German (C1/C2) is mandatory for official communications with
authorities, schools, and parents. Strong English skills (B2/C1) are
required for internal collaboration in our international corporate
environment. Pedagogical Drive: Exceptional communication skills with
the ability to motivate, resolve conflicts, and guide Gen-Z young
adults through their personal and professional development.
Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, semiconductor
fab safety regulations, and the technical demands of Microtechnology
(Mikrotechnologe/In). Experience setting up apprenticeship structures
in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &
Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement
opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company
Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial
well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee,
you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an
exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Support for
Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you
will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training &
Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper
understanding of the processes involved in operating complex
semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you
continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An annual
budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes,
massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals & Transportation:
Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public
transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume.

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For

committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are

sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract

jobs.employer_name: Construction Tools Solution Ce nter GmbH
jobs.description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Using state-of-the-art technology, Epiroc develops and manufactures innovative drilling equipment and machinery for rock excavation and construction, as well as providing first-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden. Its dedicated employees support and work closely with customers in more than 150 countries.

Do you want to make a real difference? Rock the future with a global player? Then join our team and get the ball rolling as a

Technical Product Specialist Smart Solutions (m/w/d)

Moving forward with inspiration

Key focus areas are

- Support the development, testing, and validation of innovative hydraulic attachment and smart machine solutions from concept through market launch.
- Participate in prototype assembly, field trials, product evaluations, and customer acceptance testing.
- Provide practical field feedback to Engineering, Product Management, and Service organizations to drive product improvements and customer-focused solutions.
- Assist customers and internal stakeholders in the successful adoption and deployment of smart technologies and digital solutions.
- Support root cause analysis and troubleshooting of new products and systems during field implementation.
- Execute service assignments, repairs, maintenance activities, commissioning, inspections, and troubleshooting at customer sites and in the workshop.
- Deliver technical training and operational guidance to customers and business partners.
- Provide professional technical advice regarding equipment operation, repairs, maintenance requirements, and spare parts recommendations.
- Prepare detailed and accurate service reports, machine condition assessments, and technical product reports.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives through the sharing of technical knowledge and field experience.

Strong skills

You are committed, like to take on responsibility and want to gain a deep insight into supply chain work. Ideally, you have the following skills:

- Completed technical vocational education or an equivalent qualification in mechanics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, hydraulics, or a related technical discipline.
- Strong knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and machine diagnostic systems.
- Experience within the mining, construction equipment, heavy machinery, or a related industry.
- Ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions in the field.
- Good understanding of common IT tools and digital service technologies.
- Experience with customer-facing technical service activities is highly desirable.
- Excellent German language skills, both written and spoken, together with basic English language skills.

More for you

Those who do a lot should also get a lot. That's why you'll benefit from an extensive range of offers that leaves almost nothing to be desired. And if you do? We are constantly working on expanding and improving our range of services - just get in touch. Here is a small excerpt of what you can expect:

Benefits in everyday working life

- Further training and development: you can still learn something with us

Career and studies

- Flexible working time models and home office options
- Gain experience in international cooperation, as you will be in regular contact with our global subsidiaries within the Epiroc Group
- Opportunity to gain professional experience parallel to your studies with the prospect of writing your thesis in an international environment

Health, sport and leisure

- Modern office equipment, free drinks
- Team events such as midsummer parties, workshops, barbecues and more

With united strength into the future

Have we inspired you? Then let's shape the future together: with innovation and commitment - and above all united. Simply apply online now via our career portal. Please let us know your earliest possible starting date.

We look forward to welcoming you to our team! We welcome applications from all people, regardless of their cultural and social background, age, religion, ideology, disability or sexual identity.

United. Inspired. Performance unites us, innovation inspires us and commitment drives us to develop further. In the 150 countries where you will find Epiroc, we encourage our employees to take responsibility for their own development and career with the support of their managers. We are committed to providing you with every opportunity to succeed in a culture of innovation, diversity and collaboration, combined with a caring atmosphere. Diversity and sustainability are key to developing fresh and innovative ideas and solutions for our customers. Epiroc is a leading manufacturer for the mining and infrastructure industry. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com (https://javascript:void(0);)

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Institute for Pharmacology and Toxicology
Ref.-Nr.  601-2026
Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine is an integral part of the Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg and cooperates with the Magdeburg University Hospital A.ö.R. in research, teaching and patient care.

Your Responsibilities:

We are seeking two highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellows to join our team investigating the molecular and cellular organization of the nervous system using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics approaches. The successful candidates will work at the interface of neuroscience, genomics, and computational biology to map gene expression patterns across brain tissue with spatial resolution, contributing to our understanding of neural circuit organization, development, and disease.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, well-resourced research environment with access to state-of-the-art spatial profiling platforms (e.g., MERFISH, 10x Visium), advanced microscopy, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Two positions are available with complementary focus:

- Position 1 — Experimental/Wet-lab focus: Designing and executing spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue, including tissue preparation, probe design, imaging, and data generation
- Position 2 — Computational/Analytical focus: Developing and applying computational pipelines for spatial transcriptomic data analysis, including cell-type mapping, spatial statistics, and integration with single-cell/single-nucleus datasets

(Candidates with strong interest and skills spanning both areas are also encouraged to apply and may be considered for either position.)

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, plan, and conduct spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue samples
- Analyze and interpret complex spatial and single-cell genomic datasets
- Collaborate with neuroscientists, computational biologists, and clinicians within and outside the group
- Present findings at lab meetings, seminars, and international conferences
- Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication
- Contribute to grant writing and mentoring of graduate/undergraduate students
- Maintain rigorous documentation and adhere to good research and data management practices

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications:

- A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Neuroscience, Molecular/Cell Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field
- Demonstrated research productivity (peer-reviewed publications and/or preprints)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

For the experimental-focus position, in addition:

- Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, RNA-seq library prep)
- Experience with spatial transcriptomics platforms (e.g., Visium, MERFISH, Xenium, seqFISH) is highly desirable
- Experience with rodent or human brain tissue handling is a plus

For the computational-focus position, in addition:

- Strong programming skills (Python and/or R)
- Experience analyzing single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial transcriptomics data
- Familiarity with relevant packages/tools (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, STUtility) and statistical/machine learning methods
- Experience with high-performance/cluster computing is a plus

We offer:

- Access to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and imaging technology
- A collaborative, interdisciplinary, and supportive research environment
- Funding and support to attend international conferences
- Opportunities for career development, mentoring, and grant-writing training
- Work and family in harmony: Through Klinikzwerge (https://kita.med.ovgu.de/) , childcare may be available, subject to availability
- Help protect the environment and enjoy discounted public transportation through a job ticket
- In addition, we offer a diverse range of sports and relaxation activities as part of our workplace health promotion program
- Onboarding: At the start of your employment, you will participate in our orientation program, where you will receive important information and training sessions

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder” awaits you
- **Appointment: **The position is to be filled as a full-time position, with a workload of 2,5 years, starting on 2027/01/01

approaches for the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.

Your role in detail

- Daily maintenance and user support as well as long-term planning of our IT
infrastructure (servers, storage, backup solutions, high performance computing)
for a research institute with 120 people generating and analysing large amounts
of imaging and genetic data.
- You will be responsible for the provision of server systems, monitor
productive operation and keep the systems up to date with the latest technology
in close interaction with the central IT services responsible for standard IT
functionality (network, data and user account management, etc.) at our
headquarters in Bonn. Togelher you will plan and implement the provision of
systems for special scientific requirements and implement the specified safety
concepts.
- Support of scientific and non-scientific users of the IT systems at the
DZNE Munich site. This includes the setup of computers (PC and Mac) with
operating systems and user software, maintenance and updating of existing
computers, advice on new acquisitions and immediate user support. You will work
on projects and be responsible for IT support in the projects.
- Supported by IT operations, you will provide users with central resources
such as disk space and perform the installation and configuration of new
systems.

Your profile in cutting edge research

- You have a degree from a university of applied sciences as a computer
scientist, a completed IT training as an IT technical assistant or a comparable
training
- You have several years of experience in system administration and user
support for a modern Windows-MacOS X network
- You have a good knowledge of Server, HyperV, Exchange Server and Sharepoint
- You have very good knowledge in the area of hardware and software, and
especially in the area of client and server operating systems (Windows Server)

- We appeal to dynamic personalities who have a high degree of
self-motivation, communication skills, assertiveness and competence
- You enjoy working in a team with highly motivated colleagues to find
solutions to complex problems
- You are detail-oriented and have good communication and documentation skills
- A very good command of English and a good command of German is a
prerequisite
